name: Npc
lead: A player-shaped entity every client from 1.8 sees, from `world.npc`; it can walk, talk, hold items, wear armour and ride.

functions.name: look_at
functions.description: Where it stands; live, so setting it moves the NPC. A riding NPC reads the seat's position. Partial writes preserve other angles; nil after removal. Bodies have no roll. Turns head and body toward a point.

functions.name: hold
functions.description: Puts an item in the main hand; nil or false empties it. An error on an unknown item.

functions.name: say
functions.description: Sends a chat line "<name> ..." to the room, or just the words for an NPC with no name.

functions.name: walk
functions.signature: npc:walk(opts: { path: { Vec3 }, speed: number ?, loop: boolean ? }?)
functions.description: Walks the points by itself, facing where it goes; nil stops it.

functions.name: wear
functions.description: Puts armour on it, head first; each piece is an item.

functions.name: ride
functions.signature: npc:ride(thing: MountTarget, opts: { seat: number ? }?) → boolean
functions.description: Sits in a seat as `player:ride` does, and never drives; `false` when somebody sits there.

functions.name: dismount
functions.description: Gets off where it sits; set `at` after it to put it somewhere else.

functions.name: move
functions.description: Removes the NPC. Sets position and optional rotation together.

fields.name: id
fields.description: The entity id, what `players.on_click` reports in `hit.entity_id`.

fields.name: name
fields.description: Whether it is still present. Read-only. "" for one made with no name, which has no name tag.

fields.name: walking
fields.description: True while it walks a path, until the last point; never false with `loop`.

fields.name: pose
fields.description: How the body is held; live.

fields.name: riding
fields.description: Whether it sits in a seat; live.
